name: Small Pockets
body:
You have stretched your pockets out to allow for better storage.

Prerequisites: Otterling, otterling tiny pockets racial trait.

Benefit: Your tiny pockets are able to hold up to two potions, a single small object that could fit in your hand, or a one-handed or light weapon sized for you.

The Book of Many Things, © 2018,Samurai Sheepdog; author Kevin Glusing.
